description: SDK capabilities query ($0.01/request direct, or $0.003/request via Session Ticket at /v1/billing/tickets)

_signals.x_guidance: Call POST /v1/air with a natural language query to get structured data, execution plans, or capability matches. Direct callers must authenticate with an API key, session ticket, or x402 payment; anonymous browser usage continues through AIR’s first-party server-side proxy. For SDK browser automation, use /v1/sdk/capabilities to discover actions. Curated seller routes are published for Bazaar-compatible discovery, while legacy /v1/extract and /v1/capabilities stay live for SDK/x402 compatibility.
